def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find rare colors: cells differing from majority
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # find rectangle of one color and single pixels of others
    cells={v:[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==v] for v in set(v for r in g for v in r) if v!=bg}
    big=max(cells,key=lambda v:len(cells[v]))
    pts=cells[big]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    hgt=h:=r1-r0+1; wds:=c1-c0+1
    single=[v for v in cells if v!=big][:1]
    mark=single[0]
    m=(next(p for p in cells[mark])[0], next(p for p in cells[mark])[1])
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # place rectangle copy of big color
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            out[i][j]=big
    # block of mark: reflect marker position relative to rect, scaled to rect dims
    # guess: block anchored so that marker maps like the corner reflection
    if m[0]<r0 and m[1]<c0:  # up-left -> down-left, cols mirrored? 
        b_r=r1+1
        b_c=c1+1-(m[1]-c0)   # mirror horizontally about left edge? try c0-m[1]+c1
        for i in range(b_r,b_r+hgt):
            for j in range(max(0,b_c-wds),b_c):
                out[i][j]=mark
    return out

import os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
# 3-rect rows17-20 cols5-8 (4x4). marker 8 at (21,4): below-LEFT of rect.
# Output 8-shape: rows21-24 cols1-4 (4x4) + rows25-26 col0 (partial 5th copy clipped).
# Step from rect to first copy: down 4, left 4 (= rect dims). Continued copies clip.
# So rule: tile copies of the rectangle shifted by (±dims) repeatedly in the direction indicated by the marker, recoloring to marker color? But marker itself disappears?
# In demo output, rect stays 3s. copies in color 8 (the marker color). marker position becomes part of block (21,4 is 8).
# Hypothesis: replicate rectangle in marker color, tiled diagonally repeating by (±h,±w) in direction(s) of marker.
def solve(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in set(cnt) if v!=bg]
    # biggest area = rect
    cells={v:[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==v] for v in others}
    big=max(cells,key=lambda v:len(cells[v]))
    pts=cells[big]; rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs); h=r1-r0+1; w=c1-c0+1
    mark=[v for v in others if v!=big][0]
    mpts=cells[mark]; mp=mpts[0]
    out=[[bg]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # place rect copies
    offs=[]
    dr = mp[0]- (r1 if mp[0]>r1 else r0)  # sign of vertical relation
    dc = mp[1]-(c1 if mp[1]<c0 else c0)
    dr=1 if mp[0]>=r1 else -1
    dc=-1 if mp[1]<=c0 else 1
    # direction: marker below -> extend downward; marker left of rect -> extend leftward; opposite col side -> rightward
    dy,dz=dr*1,dc*1
    off_r,r0_ = r1+dy, r0-dy
    # generate offsets: repeat while in bounds
    k=0
    offs.append((off_r,r0_))
    while True:
        rr=r0_-k*h if False else None
        break
    offs.append((off_r, r0_))
    # actually offsets: start at (r1+dy, r0-dy), then step (dy, dz)*h... careful: horizontal step also ±w based on horizontal direction
    hr_step = h*dy; wr_step = w*dz if (mp[1] < c0 and dc==-1) else (w if mp[1] > c1 and dc==1 else 0)
    off_r, off_c = r1+ (h if dy==1 else -h), c0- (w if dz==1 else -w)
    offs=[(off_r,off_c)]
    while True:
        nr,nc=offs[-1][0]+hr_step,offs[-1][1]+wr_step
        if abs(nr)<H and abs(nc)<W: offs.append((nr,nc))
        else: break
    for ar,ac in offs:
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                rr,cc=ar+i,ac+j
                if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=mark
    return out
print(solve(I)==O)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
